title: Regression: WO Part and Customer dialogs with custom footers render and save after the BaseFormDialog change
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: an open work order at Staging Heavy Duty with a part line (e.g. QAPL-T1); an existing customer. DevTools Network tab open; throttling No throttling unless a step says otherwise.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order > open the part line's WO Part dialog.
  2. Change the part line's quantity > Save, then reload the work order.
  3. Reopen the WO Part dialog, set DevTools throttling to Slow 3G, change the quantity back > Save, and click Save again while the request is pending.
  4. Set throttling back to No throttling. Reopen the WO Part dialog, change a value and close it with its X.
  5. Customers > open the customer > open the Customer dialog (edit).
  6. Change a field (e.g. phone or notes) > Save, then reload the customer.
  7. Reopen the Customer dialog, change a field and close it with its X.
custom_expected:
1. The dialog opens with its title and X as before, and its own footer buttons render in place.
  2. The dialog closes; the line shows the new quantity, which persists after the reload.
  3. Only one save request is sent; when it lands the dialog closes and the original quantity is saved (no stuck spinner or doubled save).
  4. The dialog closes without saving; the line keeps its saved value.
  5. The dialog opens with its title, X and its own footer buttons in place.
  6. The dialog closes and the change persists after the reload.
  7. The dialog closes without saving; the customer keeps its saved values.
